payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the methods used for extracting clusters, particularly through the use of word embeddings and classification techniques.

claims.text: Clusters were extracted by incorporating cluster membership features into the feature extraction pipeline for various NLP tasks.
The selection of word vectors and the number of clusters is a trial-and-error procedure, indicating a flexible approach to cluster extraction.
Out-of-domain embeddings trained on Wikipedia were used to produce clusters that performed well in the tasks.
The approach involves classifying instances and aggregating counts to form clusters.
